caption: A long steel saw blade is dropped flat onto a bench, and the blade twangs and flutters for a moment before lying still.

sa.check: A long steel saw blade and a bench.
The blade is dropped and lands on the bench.
The blade lands flat, not on its edge or tip.
The order is landing, flutter, still.

pc.expect: The blade falls as a stiff sheet and starts to flutter as it hits the bench and only then; once still it stays still.
pc.fail: The blade flutters in mid-air before touching the bench; or lies on the bench and begins fluttering with nothing touching it; or hits the bench and lies dead still with no flutter at all; or starts fluttering again after lying still.

pc.expect: The flutter is strongest at the impact and dies away to stillness.
pc.fail: The flutter grows after the impact; or continues unchanged to the end of the clip; or the blade stops dead in mid-flutter with one end raised.

pc.expect: The blade falls downward onto the bench and stays on the bench surface.
pc.fail: The blade hovers before landing; or rises after landing; or a raised end stays lifted off the bench with nothing under it.

pc.expect: The blade flexes as a springy steel strip: it bows and rings flat again; the bench stays rigid.
pc.fail: The blade folds and stays bent; or bends like rubber into a deep curve; or the bench top dents or ripples where it lands; or the teeth bend over.

pc.expect: One blade and one bench; the blade passes through nothing and stays one piece.
pc.fail: The blade passes into the bench; or splits in two; or vanishes; or a second blade appears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The blade's teeth, the bench and anything lying on it stay the same.
pc.fail: The blade's teeth change pattern; or the bench changes colour; or tools on the bench move by themselves.

note: The twang is inaudible and is not judged; the flutter is its visible sign.
